intro: This errand directs Alliance adventurers in Stormwind to Tinker Town in Ironforge, where Tinkmaster Overspark is mourning a tragic malfunction. Brother Sarno sends word that Overspark's mechanical creation, Techbot, has gone rogue amidst the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan. Reaching the Tinkmaster is the first step toward recovering the wayward construct's memory core.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot. I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.
Very sad. But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!
Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in Ironforge. He would welcome your help.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes it's true. Techbot has gone rogue! Please, can you help me?
